fetchTypeName.description: The name of the type of objects returned in the {@link FetchResult} of the mocked action.

specParameterName.description:
The name of the parameter of the mocked action that contains the {@link FetchSpec}.  In most
cases, this is 'spec'.

returnArray.description:
If true, the mocked action returns just an array of objects.  If false, it returns a
{@link FetchSpec} containing the objects.

title:
An extension of {@link TestApiSpy} used specifically for fetch calls.  It sets up the mock function
based on a provided list of results and handles order, limit, and offset.  It currently does not
automatically handle filter or include, but the 'preprocessFunction' argument of withResults
can be used to handle expected cases.

The order field in the {@link FetchSpec} will work only if its value is in one of these formats:
- fieldName
- ascending(fieldName)
- ascending(fieldName,...)
- descending(fieldName)
- descending(fieldName,...)

If there is more than one field in the order, only the first one is used.

Calling callFake() or returnValue() on this object will overwrite the mock function generated by
withResults().

Example usage:
- regular fetch call
```
TestApiSpy.spyOnFetch(ctx, "FakeType")
          .withResults([{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'y', a: 3}, {id: 'z', a: 2}])
          .register()
```
`FakeType.fetch({order: 'a'}).objs => [{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'z', a: 2}, {id: 'y', a: 3}]`

- return modified results if a specific include value is specified
```
function handleInclude = function (objs) {
  if (input.spec.include === 'id') {
    objs = _.map(objs, function (obj) {
      return {
        id: obj.id
      };
    });
  }
  return objs;
};

TestApiSpy.spyOnFetch(ctx, "FakeType")
          .withResults([{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'y', a: 3}, {id: 'z', a: 2}], handleInclude)
          .register()

```
`FakeType.fetch({order: 'a'}).objs => [{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'z', a: 2}, {id: 'y', a: 3}]`
`FakeType.fetch({order: 'a', include: 'id'}).objs => [{id: 'x'}, {id: 'z'}, {id: 'y'}]`

- fetch-like call that returns a FetchSpec<OtherFakeType>:
```
TestApiSpy.spyOnFetch(ctx, "FakeType", "fetchOtherFakeType", "OtherFakeType")
          .withResults([{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'y', a: 3}, {id: 'z', a: 2}])
          .register()
```
`FakeType.fetchOtherFakeType({order: 'a'}).objs => [{id: 'x', a: 1}, {id: 'z', a: 2}, {id: 'y', a: 3}]`
name: TestApiFetchSpy
